raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience
Logistics - Dr. Lal PathLabs :
Contributed to building Logistics Management System for handling transportation of blood samples, cash collections, and other critical medical items across network routes.
Support with Frontend activities.
Optimized several performance-heavy queries, reducing response times and improving system stability for high-volume logistics operations.
Designed and implemented a Communication Engine Service to streamline communication between field staff, transport units, and internal systems.
Improved backend reliability by refactoring legacy modules, optimizing database indexing, and restructuring API logic for better scalability.
Collaborated closely with logistics teams to understand ground-level workflows and translate them into efficient backend processes and automated flows.
Ensured secure data handling and compliance with medical and operational requirements during the transportation and tracking of sensitive items.
Dr. Lal PathLabs :
Single-handedly developed a new premium brand platform for Dr. Lal PathLabs, delivering a modern and scalable experience for high-value users.
Quickly analyzed and understood a 7-year-old legacy codebase, refactoring critical parts to improve performance, stability, and compatibility with new features.
Implemented new backend modules for doctor consultation, diet consultation, questionnaires, and service-wise test completion, enhancing user engagement and service personalization.
Built robust, extensible REST APIs to integrate premium features with existing systems while maintaining backward compatibility with the legacy architecture.
Collaborated closely with product and operations teams, providing continuous support and ensuring rapid, high-quality delivery within a tight timeline.
Demonstrated strong ownership by handling requirement analysis, development, testing, optimization, and deployment with minimal supervision.
Billing Management System :
Single-handedly architected and developed a full Billing Management System using KeystoneJS, covering employees, projects, billing cycles, and reporting workflows.
Designed and implemented RESTful APIs using Keystone’s schema and relationship model, enabling fast, reliable, and scalable data interactions.
Leveraged KeystoneJS’s advanced relationship management to build complex data structures—supporting project allocations, employee billing, and multi-level approval flows.
Optimized data retrieval through Keystone’s built-in query features, ensuring efficient filtering, pagination, and aggregation for large datasets.
Built secure authentication and role-based access control to streamline operations for admins, managers, and employees.
Delivered the entire solution end-to-end—including database modeling, API architecture, business logic, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
Home Title Lock :
Led end-to-end data migration, designing secure migration scripts in Node.js and ensuring high data integrity for US land-title protection records.
Built reusable, modular backend components to streamline API development, reduce code duplication, and improve maintainability across the platform.
Implemented payment gateway integrations (e.g., subscriptions, refunds, upgrades/downgrades) with robust error handling and idempotent transaction workflows.
Developed and optimized subscription management services, including automated billing logic, plan changes, renewal flows, and customer lifecycle updates.
Enhanced security measures for user identity, subscription data, and land-registration information to help protect US homeowners from title-related fraud.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to improve system reliability, introduce logging/monitoring, and support deployment of new features in production.
Value to the Organization:
Consistently deliver end-to-end backend solutions—reducing development time, improving system performance, and enabling faster release cycles.
Modernize and optimize legacy systems, improving reliability, scalability, and long-term maintainability across critical healthcare and logistics platforms.
Build clean, reusable APIs and optimized data workflows that lower operational costs and enhance user experience for both internal teams and end customers.
